SQL.meta: /*dp1p:meta*/ SELECT (extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000)::bigint::text AS now_ms, current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS ro
SQL.queue: /*dp1p:queue*/ SELECT status, count(*)::int AS n, min(received_at)::text AS oldest FROM signals WHERE status IN ('QUEUED','PROCESSING') GROUP BY status
SQL.live: /*dp1p:live*/ SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM signals WHERE execution_mode='LIVE'
SQL.heartbeat: /*dp1p:heartbeat*/ SELECT last_tick::text AS last_tick FROM worker_heartbeats WHERE role='execution'
SQL.baseline: /*dp1p:baseline*/ SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM signals WHERE status='REJECTED' AND error_message LIKE 'EXECUTION_FAULT:%') AS faults, (SELECT COALESCE(max(id),0)::text FROM signals) AS max_signal, (SELECT COALESCE(max(id),0)::text FROM audit) AS max_audit
SQL.audit: /*dp1p:audit*/ SELECT event, count(*)::int AS n FROM audit WHERE event IN ('worker.systemic_suspected','order.execution_fault','ledger.cost_clamped','ledger.cost_divergence') GROUP BY event
SQL.exposed: /*dp1p:exposed*/ SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM ledger_position_allocations WHERE execution_mode='PAPER' AND status='OPEN' AND remaining_quantity>0 AND scale(trim_scale(remaining_quantity*entry_price))>18
SQL.candidateFills: /*dp1p:candidateFills*/ SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM signals WHERE id>$1::bigint AND status='FILLED' AND execution_mode='PAPER' AND broker_response LIKE '%paper-exit-cost-v2%'

limits: TEXT LIKE counts malformed text containing the v2 substring; this does not validate JSON or marker authenticity.
SQL compatibility and predicate checks do not establish booking correctness or production readiness.
Applicable Linux evidence, actual installed dependencies, staging 24-hour observation and production/policy gates remain separate.
effects: Fresh isolated local PostgreSQL only; no host action or production change.
